content:
The map shows the meadow is enclosed except a gap at (11,3) leading north — that's the pass. Route: from (4,7) go east along row 7 to x=11, then north through (11,3) to (11,1) where the shrine chest is.

The interact button vocabulary is still unknown, but walking is enough to reach the chest; I'll attempt interact with a couple of remaining plausible ids at the chest, and if the chest needs a specific input the small brain will report it.

args.approach: It is now day 7, so the Rockslide Pass is open — drop the farming detour and go straight for the goal: walk east along row 7 to x=11, north through the pass gap at (11,3), up to the Old Shrine chest at (11,1), then try opening it.
